export const initialReports = [
  {
    id: "CEGCT-2025-0042",
    category: "Illegal dumping",
    severity: "CRITICAL",
    status: "SUBMITTED",
    location: "Area 18, Lilongwe",
    date: "Today, 09:42",
    reporter: "Grace Banda",
    officer: "Unassigned",
    description:
      "Large pile of construction waste dumped beside the stream. Runoff is entering the waterway.",
    lat: "-13.925",
    lon: "33.781",
    image:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1605600659873-d808a13e4d9a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80",
  },
  {
    id: "CEGCT-2025-0041",
    category: "Water pollution",
    severity: "HIGH",
    status: "UNDER_REVIEW",
    location: "Msambazi River, Mzuzu",
    date: "Today, 08:16",
    reporter: "Peter Phiri",
    officer: "Martha Chirwa",
    description:
      "Discoloured water and a strong chemical smell reported near the footbridge.",
    lat: "-11.465",
    lon: "34.020",
    image:
      "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1437482078695-73f5ca6c96e2?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80",
  },
  {
    id: "CEGCT-2025-0040",
    category: "Unsafe waste disposal",
    severity: "MEDIUM",
    status: "IN_PROGRESS",
    location: "Zomba Central Market",
    date: "Yesterday, 16:30",
    reporter: "Thoko Mbewe",
    officer: "James Nkhoma",
    description: "Waste is being burned behind the market after closing hours.",
    lat: "-15.385",
    lon: "35.318",
  },
  {
    id: "CEGCT-2025-0039",
    category: "Air pollution",
    severity: "HIGH",
    status: "IN_PROGRESS",
    location: "Chilomoni, Blantyre",
    date: "Yesterday, 13:05",
    reporter: "Chisomo Juma",
    officer: "Martha Chirwa",
    description: "Smoke from an industrial site is affecting nearby homes.",
    lat: "-15.786",
    lon: "35.002",
  },
  {
    id: "CEGCT-2025-0038",
    category: "Illegal dumping",
    severity: "LOW",
    status: "RESOLVED",
    location: "Kawale, Lilongwe",
    date: "Oct 04, 11:20",
    reporter: "Andrew Kalua",
    officer: "James Nkhoma",
    description:
      "Household refuse left along the roadside has now been cleared.",
    lat: "-13.954",
    lon: "33.777",
  },
];
export const officers = [
  "Martha Chirwa",
  "James Nkhoma",
  "Ruth Moyo",
  "Unassigned",
];
export const statuses = [
  "SUBMITTED",
  "UNDER_REVIEW",
  "IN_PROGRESS",
  "RESOLVED",
  "REJECTED",
];
export function formatLabel(value = "") {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll("_", " ")
    .replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase());
}
